verdict.rationale: Vestd advertises a shareholder/employee dashboard ('Invite your team' via shareholder-dashboards page) and an options-exercise workflow where recipients submit requests, implying some self-service portal exists, but there is no evidence describing vesting-progress visualization, strike price display, or scenario/what-if valuation modeling for employees. missing for 10: explicit portal screenshots or docs showing vesting progress bars, strike price display, and outcome/scenario modeling for equity value.
